qa: independent behavior QA, Claude Opus 5.5 (fresh context, separate from author and reviewer)
verdictScale: PASS | FAIL | GAP (not established by this QA) | PASS+GAP (behaviour passes; a stated limit or documentation precision issue remains)
authoritativeRun: observations/run-02 (driver/qa448-driver.run-02.mjs); run-01 retained with its strict-expectation failures

criteria.criterion: Source, tree, runtime, lockfile and build binding
criteria.facts: HEAD b45807f, parent 02351e2, clean before/after; diff byte-identical to author candidate.diff (sha256 6269f388...); 7 file hashes equal author manifest; lockfile blob unchanged from base; Node v22.23.4, pnpm 12.8.1; single pnpm build exit 0 (12/12 tasks, infrastructure+api cache miss, 5 unchanged packages replayed); dist contains projectStartupModelCatalog at both call sites.

criteria.criterion: Offline --preflight and ordinary startup share the pure stored-first projection
criteria.facts: Built preflight.js:429 and container.js:80 call projectStartupModelCatalog. M01: stored rows first in stored order, input unmutated, idempotent, only missing pair appended. Same store+GG_DEFAULTS admitted by built CLI (P01) and booted by built gateway (S01); S06/S07 show boot sees the projected (missing) seed as another harness's model (MODEL_HARNESS_MISMATCH).

criteria.criterion: Missing shipped Codex+Claude seeds admitted in memory only by offline --preflight (external percent-encoded path, inside GG_DATA_DIR, WAL-only missing rows)
criteria.facts: Exit 0; ok Database reachable and migrated; ok Default model gpt-6.1-terra (codex) is in the model catalog; ok Claude default model. Rows still absent afterwards (11 rows, independent re-read); data dir still absent for external cases.

criteria.criterion: Offline --preflight writes nothing: no seed/refresh/migrate; DB/WAL bytes and logical rows unchanged (-shm reader changes allowed)
criteria.facts: All 18 CLI cases: DB sha256 unchanged, logical hash, catalog rows/rowcount, migration ledger, format marker, schema_version/user_version unchanged; no rollback journal. Existing WAL byte-identical (P03 16512 B, P18). GAP: on a WAL-mode store with no -wal file, every read-only open (built openReadOnlyDatabaseClient, built guardCurrentStore alone, independent node:sqlite readOnly; M05) creates a 0-byte -wal and 32 KiB -shm. Zero frames; not attributable to #448 (unchanged guard path; also on unsupported store P15 and startup refusals S05-S11). Strictly, CHANGELOG/docs/11 'database and WAL bytes remain unchanged' does not mention that an empty -wal file can appear.

criteria.criterion: Ordinary startup on a separate copy accepts the same missing-seed config and seeds normally
criteria.facts: Built gateway listening (healthz pid = owned child); GET /model-catalog both seeds enabled; GET /system/model-defaults = GG_DEFAULTS; GET /system/preflight database/default-model/default-model.claude ok; drained exit 0; stored rows 11 -> 13, ledger/marker unchanged, no pre-existing enabled flag changed. S02 covers WAL-only missing rows inside GG_DATA_DIR.

criteria.criterion: Existing exact (harness, model) rows win: disabled same-seed-id rows and stored metadata
criteria.facts: Disabled row stays disabled in projection (single entry), offline and after boot. Stored Claude efforts [high] override shipped metadata: low refused offline (P10) and at boot (S09, EFFORT_UNSUPPORTED); high admitted (P11).

criteria.criterion: D172 distinct policies: Codex disabled default WARN/exit 0; Claude disabled default FAIL/exit 1; boot rejects only invalid (not unavailable) and preserves the disabled row; disabled model unavailable to execution
criteria.facts: P04: WARN Default model 'gpt-6.1-terra is in the model catalog but disabled', exit 0. P05: FAIL Claude default model 'The configured Claude model is disabled', exit 1. S03/S04: gateway boots; GET /model-catalog enabled:false; validate MODEL_DISABLED severity warning, publishable false; publish 422 LOOP_INVALID; draft run 202 then failed EVALUATION_UNAVAILABLE details.code MODEL_DISABLED; isAllowed false; resolveHarnessModel unavailable/MODEL_DISABLED; validateHarnessDefaults []. Fakes saw only probes during the run.

criteria.criterion: Unknown, wrong harness/family and unsupported effort remain invalid
criteria.facts: Offline FAIL/exit 1 for unknown, wrong-harness, wrong-family, Claude effort none. Boot refuses before writes with EVALUATION_INVALID_CONFIGURATION + MODEL_NOT_IN_CATALOG / MODEL_HARNESS_MISMATCH / EFFORT_UNSUPPORTED; DB bytes and logical rows unchanged. Existing asymmetry retained: Codex preflight does not check effort (P12 ok) while boot refuses gpt-5.5/none (S10).

criteria.criterion: First-run, unsupported, unreadable, pending-migration, external-path and WAL read-only guards unchanged
criteria.facts: P13/P14 nothing created; P15 format 3 FAIL with reset guidance; P16 SQLITE_NOTADB FAIL; P17 '1 migration(s) pending' WARN, ledger stays 29; S11 startup refuses format 3. GAP: 'unchanged versus base' rests on source equivalence (store-format.ts, db.ts, readiness.ts unchanged; preflight/container diffs only touch the catalog expression) - the base binary was not built or run (single build slot).

criteria.criterion: Discrimination: the candidate change is what admits the missing seeds
criteria.facts: Same missing-seed store through built runPreflight: candidate catalog source -> default-model ok, default-model.claude ok; stored-only catalog source -> both fail. Boot validator with stored-only catalog -> codex and claude MODEL_NOT_IN_CATALOG; with projection -> []. GAP: synthetic counterfactual at the candidate, not the base binary (author's stored-only control log is the only base-like runtime evidence).

criteria.criterion: Isolation: no owner Ollama, Codex/Claude credentials, owner ports, secrets, paid provider or model turn
criteria.facts: Children built from an empty environment with scratch USERPROFILE/HOME/APPDATA/LOCALAPPDATA/TEMP, fake Claude exe and fake Codex .mjs (probe-only; refuse anything else with exit 86), Ollama URL = local recorder. run-02: 22 x 7 probe kinds, 0 refused-non-probe; recorder saw only GET /api/tags (22). Gateway ports ephemeral, never 4747/4748/11434. Guarded focused API suite: 10 in-test fetches to 127.0.0.1:11434 blocked (test-hygiene finding).

criteria.criterion: Author focused suites re-run independently (once, no retry)
criteria.verdict: FAIL tier recorded (API PASS; infrastructure FAIL, pre-existing class)
criteria.facts: API preflight-catalog/preflight/preflight-ollama: 3 files, 61/61 passed, exit 0. Infrastructure catalog-projection/catalog/storage: 55 passed, 1 failed, exit 1 - catalog.test.ts 'reads current-format base catalog before discovery migrations without joining new tables' EBUSY unlink catalog.db. Same test and class as the author's candidate run and immutable-baseline run; that test does not call the projection. Not claimed to have vanished; cause not established.

criteria.verdict: FAIL tier recorded (native cleanup class, not a #448 product criterion)
criteria.facts: After libsql client.close(): run-01 writer and read-only files EBUSY for >= 1.25 s; run-02 writer released by 250 ms, read-only client EBUSY >= 1.25 s and removable immediately after explicit gc(). node:sqlite writer releases immediately. Consistent with the repository's own vitest comments about native handles outliving close() on Windows. All scratch files were removed after the processes exited.

run-01 and run-02: 30 owned API children each, exits 0/1 only, 0 timeouts, 0 still running. One stray wait loop of mine (bash 40164 tree) identified by unique command line and stopped with taskkill /T (4 PIDs). Nonce-verified removal of both scratch roots; 27 suite TEMP leftovers removed (prefix + creation-time attribution). Final: 0 owned process references, 0 listeners on 4747/4748/11434, tree clean.

criteria.criterion: Live provider entitlement / actual model turn
criteria.facts: No provider, credential or model turn was used; readiness is fake-CLI based. Live entitlement is not established by this QA.
Seven changed files: CHANGELOG, docs/11, apps/api container/preflight(+test), infrastructure settings(+test). No apps/web change.
